##: NetEase Cloud Music desktop client from music.163.com.

The stable link https://music.163.com/download/pc/latest is a 302 to d8.music.126.net/dmusic2/NeteaseCloudMusic_Music_official_<version>_64.exe. This manifest pins that versioned file so the recorded hash stays valid; the alias is only used by checkver.
The redirect picks 32/64-bit from the user agent (it hands out ..._32.exe to PowerShell), so checkver accepts either suffix and reads the version only.
checkver.url points at robots.txt on purpose: the version comes from the script, and the download page declares charset=utf8, which the .NET reader Scoop uses cannot resolve.
The CDN answers 403 to the default curl agent but serves Scoop's WebClient, so no useragent override is needed.

The NSIS payload keeps the whole client in redist_packages\; the installer script merges it into $dir, where locales/, package/, resource/ and swiftshader/ already sit. That merged layout is what the client expects - extracting redist_packages as-is leaves the exe one level too deep.
Only the x64 build is packaged; ..._32.exe is a separate artifact.
notes: The installer stub (UnInstall.exe, $PLUGINSDIR) is dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
User data, cache and downloaded music live under "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Netease\CloudMusic", so nothing needs to be persisted.
